job.job_title: Software Developer - BlackNgreen - Gurgaon Location - WFO 5 Days
job.job_description:
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer to build scalable product features and contribute across backend services, integrations, and UI components. The role requires strong

engineering fundamentals along with an AI-enabled development mindset to improve productivity, automation, and product innovation.




Key Responsibilities

Understand business and technical requirements and convert them into scalable and

maintainable solutions

Design and develop backend services, REST APIs, and microservices using Java and

Spring frameworks

Contribute to frontend components and user experience improvements when required
Develop high-performance features using appropriate data structures, algorithms, and

concurrency concepts

Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and indexing strategies
Work with messaging systems and asynchronous processing workflows
Integrate AI-powered capabilities into applications, automation workflows, or

engineering processes where relevant

Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity using AI-assisted

development and automation

Participate in Agile development, CI/CD pipelines, and release activities
Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement long-

term fixes

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and customers



Required Skills

Engineering Fundamentals

Strong understanding of SDLC, clean coding practices, and scalable architecture

principles

Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and multithreading
Knowledge of design patterns, secure coding, and performance optimization
Hands-on experience in database programming and performance tuning

Technology Stack

Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC
Frontend: Working knowledge of React or similar frameworks
Databases: MySQL / MariaDB with schema design and query optimization
Messaging: Kafka / ActiveMQ or similar technologies
Web Servers: Apache Tomcat or Apache HTTPD
Scripting / Automation: Python, TypeScript, or Shell scripting
Architecture: Microservices, REST APIs, distributed systems
Cloud & DevOps: Basic exposure to AWS / Azure and CI/CD pipelines
Testing: Exposure to Selenium or Robot framework



AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset (Mandatory)

Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and

documentation

Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Perplexity, or

similar platforms

Ability to validate and optimize AI-generated code for correctness, scalability,

performance, and security

Exposure to integrating AI/LLM capabilities via APIs or SDKs into applications or

internal workflows

Ability to identify automation opportunities using AI across development, testing,

monitoring, or operational processes

Awareness of data privacy, compliance, and responsible AI usage



Good to Have

Exposure to containerization technologies such as Docker
Familiarity with workflow automation tools such as n8n or similar platforms
Basic understanding of prompt engineering or AI workflow orchestration concepts
